# Read-only PG17 Task1B feasibility review

Verdict: gate a narrow Task1B successor before any dispatch. Task1A approval remains intact. This review grants NO simulation, installation, container, image, PostgreSQL, harness or dispatch authority.

## Exact reviewed inputs

- Source plan: `/home/corp/.codex/worktrees/workshop-pg17-receipts-adoption/autodata/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-04-workshop-pg17-inspected-preparation.md`, exact source HEAD `9f5c3850c9dd390f5243d7ed73713307d0fa8e70`, SHA256 `7f771d4e9c03c703626bab3e85970d4edf773c5b9960024772b684f2f0397c22`.
- Approved Task1A gate: `691f187302440509c23da99f4fb9e1adb9cd52a4`.
- Frozen accepted manifest: `/home/corp/autodata-evidence/pg17-bind-target-prep-20261104-03/evidence/accepted-apk-manifest.json`, SHA256 `cfdcb2b2c2fd4d4c449397a8c7c3c38f1cc8247d891d8aa89effb6039ca31238`.
- Successful Task1A result SHA256: `19002cbf07ce2879e277e1a3e7bc1d69ac28ae8e919e29a85bc4d7a415ee3d43`.
- Exact cached BASE: `sha256:ab20e934b27ba3ff927c1b4c9ff8cf6c32f315f743efe68dd3441182a87fb085`; RepoDigest `postgres@sha256:266d3c257594e195b309ae9d1805e54c788f1d7b375f56bf6c367aac6c917e7b`.
- Saved base-image archive SHA256: `60ae29e1f3496f1ec842b48995fcc631d9c6e918b20da48a154fd7258fa3106d`.
- Baseline: `/home/corp/autodata-evidence/pg17-bind-target-prep-20261104-03/evidence/image-baseline.json`, SHA256 `eb41e13ccdbaf76e8f84eba2a6e09af0af77376ce91ddb4564c56a3d221d9178`. Raw installed-package and trigger evidence was read from `evidence/pre-lib.stdout` in the same run.

## Prioritized findings and narrow corrections

1. [P1] Replace the installation wildcard with an exact20-APK selection. Source-plan lines105/120 submit all33 APKs, including13 baseline packages, while forbidding baseline reinstalls/replacements. All13 versions match, but explicit same-version file behavior has not been demonstrated for APK3. Preserve and verify all33 frozen APKs; pass only the20 absent package files to both simulation and installation. This is an explicit plan change, not an already approved runtime command.

2. [P1] Define offline bind-target proof explicitly. The authenticated BASE lacks `/apks` and `/control`; Task1A established that these binds create underlying root-layer directories. Line151's diff allowlist does not explicitly cover their placeholders. Carry forward reviewed created/stopped structural and context guards, permitting only proven empty root-owned target directories with exact metadata and rejecting contents, unexplained changes or path escapes. Do not silently broaden an acquisition-only guard for Task1B.

3. [P2] Preserve the inherited lock rather than demanding its absence. BASE already contains `/lib/apk/db/lock`: regular type0, uid0/gid0, mode0600, size0, empty-file SHA256 `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`. Replace line151's unqualified lock-absence language with exact preservation of this baseline record and rejection of new/transient locks. Do not delete an inherited file merely to force acceptance.

4. [P2] Make simulation acceptance deterministic. Pin exact scripts/argv/input hashes and define bounded action parsing requiring20 additions, zero baseline changes/reinstalls/removals and no unresolved dependencies. Independently reconstruct stopped simulation package/world/key/PG state to establish no installation mutation. Malformed/unknown output blocks. Ordinary baseline package descriptions containing the word error must not recreate the earlier broad-substring diagnostic false positive. Actual installation remains held for independent simulation review.

5. [P2] Account for the existing BusyBox trigger. None of the33 frozen APKs contains an install/upgrade/trigger script, but BASE retains a BusyBox trigger for `/bin`, `/usr/bin`, `/sbin`, `/usr/sbin` and module paths. It invokes `/bin/busybox --install -s` for applicable directory changes. Exact retained trigger `busybox-1.37.0-r31.X1b5405ebc02f7dd8be95b6265c54b243d5456ab8f.trigger` SHA256 `c7840b111dd82669de2074ea3c7e345c063928db2bbff650a81289777b3ff98f`. Pin its bytes and audit actual installed-state effects. Simulation success does not prove trigger/capability behavior. Unexpected paths/capability errors block; no automatic capability addition or guard relaxation.

## Read-only dependency feasibility result

All58 dependency declarations of the20 selected packages resolve in retained metadata against the45 installed BASE packages plus20 additions:36 requirements are BASE-provided and22 are newly provided. Exact equality constraints match. The only minimum-version constraints are `libssl3>=3.3.0`, supplied by BASE3.5.9-r0, and `libexpat>=2.9.0`, supplied by selected2.10.0-r0. No selected package's non-directory payload path collides with a baseline-owned file. These are metadata checks, not execution of the APK resolver and not proof of installability or trigger/capability sufficiency.

## Required successor boundary

Pin the exact accepted origin and immutable manifest hash; retain the complete33-file closure and verify all33 hashes/signatures before and after each phase. Preserve prior quarantine prohibitions. Use identical explicit20-path selection for the future `apk add --simulate --no-network` and, only after separately reviewed successful simulation, `apk add --no-network`. Retain `--network=none`, exact BASE, existing capabilities/resources and inherited PGDATA/tmp/log tmpfs, only read-only APK/control binds, no repository-source/secret/evidence mount and exact-owned cleanup/absence/complete-volume proof. Define full stopped simulation and installation state/diff audits before dispatch. Commit and final immutable image review remain Task1C; PostgreSQL/harness remain separately gated. No script/argv alteration or runtime fallback is authorized by this review.

No Docker, install, download, repository edit or GitHub mutation was performed. This local report materializes the completed read-only review without rerunning runtime operations. NO SIMULATION AUTHORITY.

busybox_trigger.name: busybox-1.37.0-r31.X1b5405ebc02f7dd8be95b6265c54b243d5456ab8f.trigger
busybox_trigger.body:
#!/bin/busybox sh

do_bb_install=

for i in "$@"; do
	case "$i" in
		/lib/modules/* | /usr/lib/modules/*)
			# don't run busybox depmod if we have kmod installed
			# we dont need to run it twice.
			target=$(readlink -f "$(command -v depmod || true)")
			if [ -d "$i" ] && [ "$target" = "/bin/busybox" ]; then
				/bin/busybox depmod ${i#*/lib/modules/}
			fi
			;;
		*) do_bb_install=yes;;
	esac
done

if [ -n "$do_bb_install" ]; then
	[ -e /bin/bbsuid ] && /bin/bbsuid --install
	[ -e /bin/busybox-extras ] && /bin/busybox-extras --install -s
	/bin/busybox --install -s
fi

pure_parser:
import re, unicodedata

def accept_simulation(stdout, stderr, selected, baseline, verified):
    assert isinstance(stdout, bytes) and isinstance(stderr, bytes)
    assert len(stdout) <= 1048576 and stderr == b""
    text = stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="strict")
    assert text.endswith("\n")
    assert all(unicodedata.category(c) != "Cc" or c in "\n\t" for c in text)
    lines = text.split("\n")[:-1]
    assert not any(re.match(r"^[ \t]*(?:WARNING:|ERROR:|UNTRUSTED(?:[ :]|$)|BAD SIGNATURE(?:[ :]|$))", line) for line in lines)
    assert len(selected) == 20 and len({name for name, version in selected}) == 20
    cursor = 0
    sections = {}
    for label in ("BASELINE_BEFORE", "VERIFY_BEFORE", "SIMULATION", "VERIFY_AFTER", "BASELINE_AFTER"):
        begin, end = "AUTODATA_PG17_" + label + "_BEGIN", "AUTODATA_PG17_" + label + "_END"
        assert lines[cursor] == begin
        cursor += 1
        start = cursor
        while cursor < len(lines) and lines[cursor] != end:
            assert not lines[cursor].startswith("AUTODATA_PG17_")
            cursor += 1
        assert cursor < len(lines)
        sections[label] = lines[start:cursor]
        cursor += 1
    assert cursor == len(lines)
    assert sections["BASELINE_BEFORE"] == baseline.splitlines() == sections["BASELINE_AFTER"]
    assert sections["VERIFY_BEFORE"] == verified.splitlines() == sections["VERIFY_AFTER"]
    actions = sections["SIMULATION"]
    assert len(actions) == 21
    expected, seen = set(selected), set()
    for number, line in enumerate(actions[:20], 1):
        prefix = f"({number:2d}/20) Installing "
        assert line.startswith(prefix)
        match = re.fullmatch(r"([a-z0-9][a-z0-9+_.-]*) \(([A-Za-z0-9+_.~-]+)\)", line[len(prefix):])
        assert match is not None
        pair = match.groups()
        assert pair in expected and pair not in seen
        seen.add(pair)
    assert seen == expected
    # No free-form postamble, scripts, triggers, progress controls, repositories or unresolved action is accepted.
    assert re.fullmatch(r"OK: (?:[0-9]{1,9}|[0-9]{1,9}\.[0-9]) (?:B|KiB|MiB|GiB|TiB) in 65 packages", actions[-1])
    return {"added": 20, "baseline_changed": 0, "simulator_output_only": True}
